answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 7869 Country: India Title: Firstly I want to know that I am using car and a two wheeler both for my job, Is zakat wajib on these two? Question: ASAK, Firstly I want to know that I am using car and a two wheeler both for my job, Is zakat wajib on these two? Answer ID: 7869 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1003/1003=M/1429) In the case mentioned above, there is no Zakah on the cost of the car and motorcycle. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
